title: Some good habit creating routines
body: Coping with stress can start feeling like a losing battle. Falling off the path becomes rambling over rocks and thorns. I’ve lived with negativity for as long as I can remember. This app helps a person like me to keep coming back to the path until gradually I forge healthier habits that are better for me. It’s important not to rush it.
